3) Keep Fri 26 Mar 09:00 ET but send a recorded highlights package + 15m live Q&A for APAC later in the day (we can record the NA/EMEA session and host a 15m async Q&A at 23:00 SGT).

Notes: option 2 minimizes confusion because EMEA will be on GMT on the 26th and move to BST on the 28th — doing the NA session after the 28th avoids the 1-hour drift for future follow-ups.
